solutions.latex:
$P(N=0)=\dfrac{2}{3}$, $P(N=1)=\dfrac{2}{9}$, $P(N\ge2)=\dfrac{1}{9}$

**Solution 1:**

\exfigure{361_q34_s1}

$P(\text{at least one month with zero claims})=1-\dfrac{1}{3}\times\dfrac{1}{3}=\dfrac{8}{9}$

$$P(N>1\mid\text{at least one zero month})=\frac{\frac{1}{9}\times\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{1}{9}}{\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\times\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{2}{3}}=\frac{\frac{4}{27}}{\frac{8}{9}}=\frac{1}{6}$$

**Solution 2:**

$$\begin{aligned}P&=1-\frac{P(0)P(0)+P(0)P(1)+P(1)P(0)}{P(0,0)+P(0,n)+P(n,0)}\\&=1-\frac{\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{2}{9}+\frac{2}{9}\times\frac{2}{3}}{\frac{8}{9}}\\&=1-\frac{\frac{4}{9}+\frac{8}{27}}{\frac{8}{9}}\\&=1-\frac{5}{6}\\&=\frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}$$

solutions.latex:
Arc $AB=12-2\sqrt{3}-3x$

$\therefore 12-2\sqrt{3}-3x=x\theta$

$\theta=\dfrac{12}{x}-\dfrac{2\sqrt{3}}{x}-3$

Area $\triangle OBC=\dfrac{1}{2}\times x^2\times\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=\dfrac{1}{2}\times x^2\times\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}x^2}{4}$

Area of sector $=\dfrac{1}{2}\times x^2\times\theta=\dfrac{x^2}{2}\theta$

Area of triangle + Area of sector:

$$\begin{aligned}A&=\frac{\sqrt{3}x^2}{4}+\frac{x^2}{2}\left(\frac{12}{x}-\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{x}-3\right)\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}x^2}{4}+6x-\sqrt{3}x-\frac{3x^2}{2}\\&=\frac{(\sqrt{3}-6)x^2}{4}+(6-\sqrt{3})x\end{aligned}$$

$\dfrac{dA}{dx}=\dfrac{(\sqrt{3}-6)x}{2}+(6-\sqrt{3})=0$

$x=\dfrac{-2(6-\sqrt{3})}{\sqrt{3}-6}=\dfrac{2(\sqrt{3}-6)}{\sqrt{3}-6}=2$

Since $\dfrac{d^2A}{dx^2}=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}-6}{2}<0$, $x=2$ gives a maximum.

$\therefore$ Total area $=\dfrac{4(\sqrt{3}-6)}{4}+2(6-\sqrt{3})=6-\sqrt{3}\ \text{km}^2$
